subject.title: Feature Request: Token Usage API for session_status Tool

question: What structured agent-facing usage contract should OpenClaw expose for `session_status` or an equivalent tool?
rationale: The missing behavior is real, but choosing fields, visibility boundaries, freshness semantics, and whether this belongs on `session_status` versus a dedicated tool is a public product/API decision.

options.title: Add `session_status.details.usage`
options.body: Expose session and last-turn usage, cost, budget, source, and availability metadata as an additive details field while keeping the rendered card unchanged.

options.title: Create a dedicated usage tool
options.body: Keep `session_status` presentation-focused and add a separate agent-facing tool that wraps the existing gateway/transcript usage readers.

options.title: Keep usage operator-only
options.body: Leave structured usage on gateway/CLI surfaces and document that agents should not receive raw usage metadata for now.

recommendation.title: Add `session_status.details.usage`
recommendation.body: Expose session and last-turn usage, cost, budget, source, and availability metadata as an additive details field while keeping the rendered card unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent status and gateway usage history makes this the best available routing candidate among the identified owners.
